base_prompt_template: {SHOT}. Editorial luxury photography, museum-grade biennale-catalogue restraint, natural or single-source light, muted paper-and-ink palette with at most one small vermilion (#C93A1E) accent, shallow depth, film grain, no text, no logos, no people's faces, generous negative space, 16:9. assets.shot: Macro shot of a matte-black robotic arm's precision gripper adjusting an articulating boom clamp holding a matte-white unbranded sneaker suspended mid-air in a dark studio module. A bright key light flares hard behind the rig, sweeping across mechanical joints and support rods, then settles to reveal the sneaker in crisp macro focus. Through a viewport at frame edge, a planet's limb and faint stars are visible; dust motes drift weightlessly through the light beam.
